appIdea.body: # #151 Electronic Health Records (EHR) (`electronic-health-records-ehr`) — Scope of Work (SOW) - **App Number:** `#151` - **App Key:** `electronic-health-records-ehr` - **Suite / Domain:** Healthcare & Wellness (`HLT` — `Hlt*`) - **Representative Benchmark (`P1`):** athenaOne (athenahealth) - **Combined Feature Set Reference:** [../combined-features/151-electronic-health-records-ehr-features.md](../combined-features/151-electronic-health-records-ehr-features.md) - **Status:** Official Architecture & Implementation Specification --- ## 1. Executive Outcome & Target Audience **Rapider Electronic Health Records (`electronic-health-records-ehr`)** eliminates clinician "pajama-time" charting fatigue, fragmented paper/fax clinical histories, dangerous medication-allergy blind spots, and unacknowledged diagnostic results. It serves as the authoritative clinical system of record and Master Patient Index (`HltPatient`) for the Rapider `HLT` suite (`#151`–`#155`), combining single-screen longitudinal charting, CPOE lab/imaging loops, e-Prescribing safety checks, HL7 FHIR R4 / C-CDA interoperability, and clinician-reviewed ambient AI documentation. ### SME Fast-Path vs. Enterprise Progressive Disclosure - **SME Fast-Path Defaults (1–15 Clinician Independent Practices & Outpatient Clinics):** Register or open a patient chart (`HltPatient`), view the single-screen Chart 360 facesheet, document a structured SOAP encounter (`HltEncounterNote`) with vitals and dot-phrases in under 3 minutes, run automatic drug-allergy checks on prescriptions (`HltMedicationPrescription`), sign off discrete lab results (`HltDiagnosticOrderResult`), and auto-emit coded ICD-10-CM / CPT encounter summaries to `#154` without complex hospital hierarchy setup. - **Enterprise Progressive Disclosure (Multi-Specialty Groups, FQHC Networks & Ambulatory Health Systems):** Progressively unlock resident/APP supervising physician co-signature queues, specialty flowsheet & behavioral scoring instruments (PHQ-9/GAD-7), DEA two-factor EPCS workflows, HL7 FHIR R4 US Core & TEFCA/C-CDA outside record reconciliation (`HltFhirExchangeBreakGlassLog`), ONC HTI-1 Decision Support Intervention (DSI) model transparency cards, and HIPAA "Break-the-Glass" VIP/behavioral chart locks. ### Measurable Business & Clinical Outcomes 1. **>= 35% Reduction in Per-Encounter Documentation Time** and **>= 85% Same-Day Chart Closure** via split-pane Chart 360 charting, reusable specialty macros, and clinician-reviewed ambient SOAP drafts. 2. **100% Point-of-Prescribing Medication Safety Screening** across active `HltAllergyIntolerance` and `HltMedicationPrescription` records with mandatory structured override logging for severe interactions. 3. **Zero Unacknowledged Critical/Panic Diagnostic Results** via automated SLA-tracked Rapider Home `WorkItem` escalations on `CRITICAL_PANIC` LOINC lab and radiology findings. 4. **100% Tamper-Evident Legal Medical Record & HIPAA Audit Compliance** through immutable `SIGNED_LOCKED` encounter locking, append-only clinical addenda, and Break-the-Glass access auditing. ### Top 6 Global Benchmark Summary (`P1`–`P6`) Synthesizes **athenaOne (`P1`)** zero-disruption cloud clinical workflows, `athenaAmbient` scribing, and care-gap prompts; **EpicCare (`P2`)** Storyboard longitudinal facesheet, CPOE order sets, and HTI-1 DSI advisories; **Oracle Health (`P3`)** AI-native clinical documentation and enterprise terminology rigor; **eClinicalWorks V12 (`P4`)** PRISMA cross-source chronological chart search; **NextGen Enterprise (`P5`)** specialty-adaptive templates and USCDI v3 compliance; and **Salesforce Health Cloud (`P6`)** HL7 FHIR R4 clinical data modeling and SDOH-aware care plans. --- ## 2. Core End-to-End User Journeys ### Journey 1: Outpatient Clinical Visit — Ambient Draft Review, Vitals, CDS eRx & Same-Day Sign-Off 1. Attending Physician opens `#/clinical-cockpit` (`findSWR`), sees roomed patient `Maya Lin (MRN-100482)` linked from `#152` (`HltAppointment`), and clicks the primary identifier to open `#/patient-chart-360?id=...`. 2. Chart 360 immediately surfaces an `ANAPHYLAXIS` Penicillin `HltAllergyIntolerance`, active Type 2 Diabetes `HltProblemCondition`, and an overdue `HbA1c` `HltCarePlanQualityGap` alongside a grounded pre-visit "What Changed" brief. 3. Physician clicks **Start / Open Encounter** (`#/encounter-charting`), reviews MA-recorded `Decimal128` vitals (`BP 128/78`, `BMI 27.4`), inspects the consented ambient AI SOAP draft (`ambientDraftStatus: AI_DRAFT_UNVERIFIED`), edits the Assessment/Plan, and explicitly clicks **Mark AI Draft Clinician-Reviewed**. 4. Physician opens `#/order-rx-drawer` to prescribe Amoxicillin—the synchronous CDS engine blocks submission due to the Penicillin `ANAPHYLAXIS` allergy! Physician switches to Azithromycin, orders an `HbA1c` lab (`LOINC 4548-4`), and saves (drawer resets button in `finally` and auto-closes). 5. Physician selects suggested `ICD-10 E11.9` and `CPT 99214`, then clicks **Sign & Lock Encounter**. `HltEncounterNote` transitions to `SIGNED_LOCKED` (immutable) and emits `hlt.ehr.encounter.signed` so `#154` generates the billing superbill and `#155` delivers the After-Visit Summary. ### Journey 2: Critical / Panic Lab Result Arrival & Closed-Loop Home `WorkItem` Escalation 1. External lab HL7 ORU / FHIR webhook delivers a `Potassium: 6.4 mmol/L` (`CRITICAL_PANIC`) result into `HltDiagnosticOrderResult` via `requiredWorkflows`. 2. `electronic-health-records-ehr` immediately publishes a high-priority Rapider Home `WorkItem` assigned to the ordering clinician and lights up the `Critical Panic Results` KPI badge on `#/clinical-cockpit` and `#/diagnostic-orders`. 3. Clinician filters `#/diagnostic-orders` by `Abnormal Flag: "CRITICAL_PANIC"` (displaying `#activeFilterTagsBar` chip), clicks the accession link, contacts the patient for urgent ED evaluation, documents follow-up action, and signs off `reviewedByProviderAt`, completing the Home `WorkItem` and releasing the result to `#155`. ### Journey 3: Nurse Practitioner / Resident Charting & Supervising Physician Co-Signature 1. Resident Physician completes an urgent-care `HltEncounterNote` and clicks **Submit for Co-Signature**, moving status to `PENDING_COSIGN` on the `#/encounters-board` `` board and generating a Home `WorkItem` for the Supervising Attending. 2. Supervising Attending reviews the note, adds a brief clinical attestation addendum, and executes `hlt.ehr.encounter.cosign`, transitioning the record to `SIGNED_LOCKED`. ### Journey 4: Restricted VIP / Behavioral Health Chart & HIPAA "Break-the-Glass" Override 1. On-call Physician searches `#/patient-directory` for an ED walk-in patient whose `HltPatient.isRestrictedChart == true`. 2. Clicking the patient opens `#/patient-chart-360` with clinical panes masked behind a custom **HIPAA Emergency Break-the-Glass Modal** (zero native `confirm()`/`prompt()`). 3. Physician selects `EMERGENCY_CARE`, enters clinical justification, and confirms; the backend writes an immutable `HltFhirExchangeBreakGlassLog` entry (`grantExpiresAt = now + 4h`), unlocks Chart 360 for that clinician session, and dispatches a mandatory audit `WorkItem` to the HIPAA Privacy Officer. ### Journey 5: External C-CDA / FHIR Transition-of-Care Ingestion & Staged Reconciliation 1. Inbound hospital discharge `ADT A03` + C-CDA arrives on `#/fhir-interoperability` (`STAGED_FOR_REVIEW`). 2. Nurse Care Coordinator opens the side-by-side reconciliation tray, accepts 2 new discharge medications and 1 CHF diagnosis into `HltMedicationPrescription` and `HltProblemCondition` (confirmed by clinician), and triggers a 7-day Transitional Care Management scheduling event to `#152`. ### Journey 6: List-to-Detail Click-Through & Filter State Restoration 1. Quality Nurse filters `#/care-plans-quality` by `Status: "OVERDUE"` and types `"Mammogram"` into search, rendering chips `Status: "OVERDUE" ✕` and `Search: "Mammogram" ✕` in `#activeFilterTagsBar`. 2. Nurse clicks patient link `MRN-100219` -> navigates cleanly to `#/patient-chart-360?id=...` without `` URL hijacking, verifies prior imaging history, and clicks `#btnGoBack` to return to `#/care-plans-quality` with both filter chips and filtered dataset preserved. --- ## 6. - **App Number:** `#151`

---

## 1. Executive Outcome & Target Audience

**Rapider Electronic Health Records (`electronic-health-records-ehr`)** eliminates clinician "pajama-time" charting fatigue, fragmented paper/fax clinical histories, dangerous medication-allergy blind spots, and unacknowledged diagnostic results. It serves as the authoritative clinical system of record and Master Patient Index (`HltPatient`) for the Rapider `HLT` suite (`#151`–`#155`), combining single-screen longitudinal charting, CPOE lab/imaging loops, e-Prescribing safety checks, HL7 FHIR R4 / C-CDA interoperability, and clinician-reviewed ambient AI documentation.

### SME Fast-Path vs. Enterprise Progressive Disclosure
- **SME Fast-Path Defaults (1–15 Clinician Independent Practices & Outpatient Clinics):** Register or open a patient chart (`HltPatient`), view the single-screen Chart 360 facesheet, document a structured SOAP encounter (`HltEncounterNote`) with vitals and dot-phrases in under 3 minutes, run automatic drug-allergy checks on prescriptions (`HltMedicationPrescription`), sign off discrete lab results (`HltDiagnosticOrderResult`), and auto-emit coded ICD-10-CM / CPT encounter summaries to `#154` without complex hospital hierarchy setup.
- **Enterprise Progressive Disclosure (Multi-Specialty Groups, FQHC Networks & Ambulatory Health Systems):** Progressively unlock resident/APP supervising physician co-signature queues, specialty flowsheet & behavioral scoring instruments (PHQ-9/GAD-7), DEA two-factor EPCS workflows, HL7 FHIR R4 US Core & TEFCA/C-CDA outside record reconciliation (`HltFhirExchangeBreakGlassLog`), ONC HTI-1 Decision Support Intervention (DSI) model transparency cards, and HIPAA "Break-the-Glass" VIP/behavioral chart locks.

### Measurable Business & Clinical Outcomes
1. **>= 35% Reduction in Per-Encounter Documentation Time** and **>= 85% Same-Day Chart Closure** via split-pane Chart 360 charting, reusable specialty macros, and clinician-reviewed ambient SOAP drafts.
2. **100% Point-of-Prescribing Medication Safety Screening** across active `HltAllergyIntolerance` and `HltMedicationPrescription` records with mandatory structured override logging for severe interactions.
3. **Zero Unacknowledged Critical/Panic Diagnostic Results** via automated SLA-tracked Rapider Home `WorkItem` escalations on `CRITICAL_PANIC` LOINC lab and radiology findings.
4. **100% Tamper-Evident Legal Medical Record & HIPAA Audit Compliance** through immutable `SIGNED_LOCKED` encounter locking, append-only clinical addenda, and Break-the-Glass access auditing.

### Top 6 Global Benchmark Summary (`P1`–`P6`)
Synthesizes **athenaOne (`P1`)** zero-disruption cloud clinical workflows, `athenaAmbient` scribing, and care-gap prompts; **EpicCare (`P2`)** Storyboard longitudinal facesheet, CPOE order sets, and HTI-1 DSI advisories; **Oracle Health (`P3`)** AI-native clinical documentation and enterprise terminology rigor; **eClinicalWorks V12 (`P4`)** PRISMA cross-source chronological chart search; **NextGen Enterprise (`P5`)** specialty-adaptive templates and USCDI v3 compliance; and **Salesforce Health Cloud (`P6`)** HL7 FHIR R4 clinical data modeling and SDOH-aware care plans.

### Out-of-Scope (Delegated to Peer Rapider Apps)
- Multi-resource clinic appointment
